description: 4 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-08-30 under road-to-governed-harness-evolution 2.4, wave 1 (3 inbound confusion edges, no corpus). Exemplars cover DESIGNING a production-LLM prompt — few-shot, chain-of-thought, system prompts, templates, self-verification. Near-misses are the neighbours the skill's own description already distinguishes itself from plus the two that named it.

queries.q: design the system prompt for our production summarizer — few-shot plus a self-verification step
what prompting pattern fits this classifier — chain-of-thought, or few-shot with a fixed schema?
build a reusable prompt template with few-shot examples for our extraction service
wie strukturiere ich den System-Prompt für unser LLM-Feature mit Few-Shot-Beispielen?
make this prompt better for ChatGPT — rewrite it
queries.note: optimising one prompt for a chat surface rather than designing a production prompt architecture → prompt-optimizer

queries.q: what is Gemini's context window and per-token price?
queries.note: a provider product fact that must be verified against official docs → llm-provider-knowledge

queries.q: review my shipped chatbot for hallucination and prompt-injection
queries.note: black-box evaluation of a running feature, not prompt authoring → evaluate-llm-feature
